candidates.title: Woman's airport security ordeal with dad's ashes highlights challenges of travelling with cremated remains
candidates.description: Rules around transporting creamated remains through airports and challenges with new scanners can add "another layer of grief" to an already stressful time, says the head of the Funeral Service Association of Canada.

candidates.title: Mild months ahead: What we know about this winter across southern Ontario
candidates.description: Historically, the average high on Nov. 19 has been around 7.5 C in Toronto, so the weather outside is noticeably warmer. That's welcome news to those who fear the cold, but should we be concerned?

candidates.description: A First Nation and chief in Manitoba's Island Lake region say they won't be able to properly govern if a court does not stop a group of people from defaming the current chief whom they attempted to oust following a financial update he gave.

candidates.title: Hearing on controversial plans to export power from Powell River to U.S. wraps up
candidates.description: An unprecedented federal hearing for an independent power producer's application to export all its electricity from a small B.C. community to the U.S. for 30 years wrapped up on Friday, after arguments from the company and local intervenors opposed to the deal.

candidates.title: N.B. publisher of Giller Prize-winning novel says win proves important stories can come out of the Maritimes

candidates.title: Tips are off the table at this Montreal café — and customers are into it
candidates.description: Café 5thFloor in the city’s LaSalle borough doesn’t take tips. Instead it pays its workers a livable wage. If customers are compelled to tip, the coffee shop takes donations that go to the non-profit, Centraide.

candidates.title: Ontario Liberals to elect new leader today after lengthy race

candidates.title: Who killed Billy Hall? Retired lawyer probes 1967 murder of Cape Breton teen
candidates.description: William (Billy) Hall was just 16 when he moved from North Sydney, N.S., to Ontario in late 1966 seeking better economic opportunities, as many of his siblings had before him. candidates.title: Calgary man who threatened to kill Prime Minister Mark Carney in TikTok, YouTube videos pleads guilty

candidates.title: Vernon to host curling's Scotties Tournament of Hearts in 2028

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'I should know better': Windsor police officer gets 2nd conditional discharge after latest guilty plea

candidates.description: * WHAT...High Water Levels 1 to 3 feet above the normal high tide line. * WHERE...Northern Seward Peninsula. * WHEN...From 9 PM Sunday to 3 AM AKST Tuesday. * IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The highest water levels will coincide with periods of high tide.
